sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Placemaking NSW (PMNSW) is seeking to establish a panel of suppliers for the supply of sawn hardwood timber and girder logs specifically for the Pyrmont Bridge Structural Restoration.The purpose of the proposed panel is to provide PMNSW with a reliable, flexible and timely supply pathway for suitable hardwood timber.
